bot: Solana memecoin trading bot (repo duliduliduli/mememe, grad-backtest/). Python, one process, deployed on Railway, trades real money through Jupiter. Values are code defaults on main (commit c818b84, 2026-09-23); Railway env vars can override them.

status_now.active_lane: copy_trading (COPY_ONLY=1). The graduation and runner lanes are in the code but switched off.
status_now.activity: Nearly idle: SCOUT_ELITE_ONLY=1 mirrors only wallets the scout has qualified, and 0 are qualified. 1 wallet is live (EC2f5DnH). Convergence is live but has not fired yet.
status_now.results_so_far: Every lane has lost money live or was never measured. Graduation lane: 52 trades, 37% win rate, +33% avg winner, -32% avg loser. Copy lane: small net losses, most losers are the full -30% stop filling at -33%.

order_each_cycle: manage open positions and exits (always first)
the scout runs on its own thread

data_sources.chain: public Solana RPC (PublicNode, mainnet-beta), WebSocket plus polling

main_loop.latency: 3-10 s from a source event to our transaction. Polling, not streaming. No Jito.

copy_lane_ACTIVE.idea: We don't pick coins ourselves. We mirror chosen wallets' conviction first-buys.
wallet_sources: COPY_WALLETS env (5 configured: EC2f5DnH, 498g1rVn, F5hkYsi8, CxWRfadz, Beqv6dzT)
wallets the scout promotes to live
copy_lane_ACTIVE.detect: Poll each wallet's recent signatures every 3 s (100-signature window). Decode balance changes: token up while SOL/WSOL/USDC/USDT goes down = buy; the reverse = sell (with the fraction of the stack sold).
buy_is_mirrored_only_if: source buy >= $300 (COPY_MIN_BUY_USD; a per-wallet override is allowed, e.g. address:300:0.5)
source tx is <= 90 s old when we see it
it is the wallet's FIRST buy of the coin (stack was empty or under 2% dust). Adds and averaging down are skipped
we don't already hold the coin and a slot is free (max 10 open, max 80% of the account deployed)
the wallet's GMGN verdict is not 'skip' (COPY_GMGN_GATE=enforce)
SCOUT_ELITE_ONLY=1: the wallet must be qualified or live in the scout with a fresh evaluation
source-exit guard: quote selling the exact tokens the source just bought; skip if that sell alone moves the price >= 30% (our stop)
every standard entry guard marked applies_to_copy=true passes
copy_lane_ACTIVE.no_rotation: When the book is full the new buy is skipped. We never sell a held coin to chase a new one.

convergence_ACTIVE.idea: Coin-level signal built from the wallets the scout is tracking.
convergence_ACTIVE.trigger: >= 2 tracked wallets from DIFFERENT relationship clusters (wallets that look commonly controlled count once) make a qualifying first buy of the same coin within 10 min

live.auto_off: after 10 closed shadow convergence trades with negative net

convergence_ACTIVE.exit: Copy exits, and the position closes when the first converging wallet sells >= 80% of its stack.

scout_wallet_discovery_ACTIVE.idea: Find wallets worth copying, paper-trade them, promote the ones that prove out.
scout_wallet_discovery_ACTIVE.discovery: Every few hours, pull candidates from GMGN smart-money and KOL feeds and from top traders of sampled tokens (what followed wallets bought, what we traded, GMGN trending). Track up to 200.
scout_wallet_discovery_ACTIVE.enrichment: 7d/30d/all stats plus up to 40 pages of buy/sell history per wallet, split into episodes (empty stack, then buy, then back to dust).

history_gates_all_mandatory.history: >= 60 days (fast track: 15 days fetched, or 30 dense episodes)
history_gates_all_mandatory.best_token_share_of_profit: <= 40%, and still net positive without the best token
history_gates_all_mandatory.fast_exit_fraction: <= 10% of first buys exited within 60 s
history_gates_all_mandatory.open_losses: unrealized losses not larger than 30d realized profit
history_gates_all_mandatory.leaderboard: top 5% on 3 snapshots over 7 days. GMGN doesn't provide this, so it is waived on the fast track

scout_wallet_discovery_ACTIVE.shadow_paper_copy: Follow candidates' first buys on-chain with real Jupiter quotes: a baseline quote, then another 20 s later as a latency stress test. Same sizing, ladder and exits as live. Nothing is swapped.

shadow_gates_full_policy.net: positive at baseline AND at +20 s
shadow_gates_full_policy.bootstrap: 95% lower bound of mean return > 0 (resampled by token and by day)

scout_wallet_discovery_ACTIVE.promotion: Fast track qualifies on history alone. At most 3 live wallets, 1 per cluster, 0.5x size, max 3 scouted positions open, $25 loss budget per wallet (paused after that). Tripwire: 10 shadow trades with negative net pauses the wallet. A qualification goes stale after 48 h.
scout_wallet_discovery_ACTIVE.result: About 200 wallets evaluated, 0 qualified under the current gates.

graduation_lane_OFF.idea: Buy pump.fun tokens right after they migrate to PumpSwap.
graduation_lane_OFF.detect: Decode pump.fun migrate/migrate_v2 plus a matching PumpSwap create_pool, via WebSocket and 30 s catch-up polling.
graduation_lane_OFF.entry: 30 s after migration. Skip if first seen more than 120 s late or more than 60 s past the target time. Every entry guard applies.

runner_lane_OFF.idea: Buy graduated tokens once they grow into a proven band with momentum. The closest thing we have to catching $200K to $4M runners.
runner_lane_OFF.watchlist: Every graduation, for 6 h, max 100 tokens. Priced every 60 s from Jupiter's batched price feed. Market cap = price x supply.
runner_lane_OFF.entry: Market cap between $400K and $4M AND >= +10% above its low of the last 15 min. The strongest gainers are bought first. Every entry guard applies.
runner_lane_OFF.weaknesses: Price-only signal (no trade count or unique-buyer check), breakout entries only, only watches pump.fun graduations

entry_filters.order: Sizing, then buy quote, then metadata and bundle lookups, then guards (first failure skips), then the executable round-trip check, then the swap.

sizing.per_position: 8% of the whole account in copy mode (10% otherwise)

guards.name: stale_entry
guards.rule: more than 60 s past target entry time

guards.name: round_trip
guards.rule: an immediate sell quote must return >= 80% of what we put in

guards.name: source_exit_impact
guards.rule: selling the source wallet's new stack would move the price >= 30%

guards.name: market_cap_ceiling
guards.rule: off (0). A $2M ceiling blocked the best bucket

guards.name: curve_age
guards.rule: graduated < 120 s after creation (one buyer filled the curve)

guards.name: curve_transactions
guards.rule: < 150 successful txs on the bonding curve (rugs seen: 2-15; organic: 311-2,293)

guards.name: creator_launches
guards.rule: creator has > 3 prior pump.fun launches (launch factory)

guards.name: early_seller
guards.rule: any wallet already sold > 3% of supply since migration

guards.name: bundle_graph
guards.rule: Inspect 50 holders and trace funding for the top 20. Block if any cluster share is over its limit: same-slot buys 30%, shared direct funder 30%, two-hop funding ancestry 20%, unpaid wallet-to-wallet token transfers 12%, coordinated buys within 12 slots 20%, wallet cohort seen on earlier launches 12%, creator-linked 15%, top-10 wallets 50%, first-3-slot buys 30%. Fails closed if lookup completion < 80% or funder coverage < 30%. At 30-60% coverage every limit is multiplied by 0.67.

entry_filters.why_copy_skips_most_guards: COPY_FAST=1. The holder and bundle analysis takes many RPC calls and would lose the race. Copied entries run only impact, round-trip and source-exit.

execution.buy: Jupiter quote then swap, 10% slippage, entry retries. A timed-out confirmation checks the wallet and adopts tokens if they landed.
execution.position_tokens: Exactly what our buy delivered, never the whole wallet balance.
execution.valuation: Batched Jupiter price feed. A real sell quote is taken only when an exit is within 8%. Copy positions are checked every 8 s.

copy_and_convergence.breakeven: once up +20%, the stop moves to entry
copy_and_convergence.ladder: sell 30% of tokens at 1.4x and 30% at 1.8x
copy_and_convergence.runner: the remaining 40% trails 40% from its peak, with no take-profit cap
copy_and_convergence.trailing_arm: no trailing stop until the position has been up +30%
copy_and_convergence.follow_source_sells: source sells >= 80% of its stack: close ours. A smaller sell trims ours by the same fraction (trims under $1 skipped). Any followed wallet's sell counts.

exits.priority: panic, then take profit, then stop loss, then trailing, then time stop. Ladder rungs are checked before exits.

moon_bags.keep: 10% of tokens, only on WINNING exits, only if worth >= $0.50
moon_bags.sell_at: 100x kept value, or once it reaches 3x, a 40% trail from its peak
moon_bags.burn: below 10% of kept value (and reclaim rent)

housekeeping.rent: Every full sell closes the token account (about 0.002 SOL). A failed close retries 4 times over about 3 min, then startup reconcile handles it.
housekeeping.startup_reconcile: Adopts orphaned tokens (small ones as moon bags), burns dust under $0.25, closes empty accounts.
housekeeping.controls: PANIC=1 sells everything and stops. HOLD_MINTS = never touch these tokens. A stop file drains the bot.

known_problems: Too slow to copy fast wallets. Large-stack wallets dump through our stop before we can sell.
Scout gates are strict and slow (days of evidence). It finds wallets, not coins, so it misses this week's runners.
No trade-activity (tape) filter anywhere: no trades-per-30s, unique-buyer or volume-trend check.
Fixed costs (slippage, fees, rent) are large relative to $5-20 positions. It needs rare 3x+ winners to profit.
Keyless Jupiter and public RPC rate limits: every added lane competes for the same quote budget.
